thread:
nora: Heads-up — I found a goroutine leak in the Go generator sample when the caller cancels via ctx. Repro: start generator, cancel after first chunk; pprof shows a goroutine stuck in handshakeLoop waiting on ackCh.

ben: i can repro. minimal snippet i used: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter := client.Generator(ctx, req)
go func() { time.Sleep(30*time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
for iter.Next() { _ = iter.Token() }
log.Println("err:", iter.Err())
```
after cancel the iterator stops but a handshake reader goroutine remains.

ashwin: likely the handshake reader isn't selecting on ctx.Done(). quick fix ideas?

mira: API ergonomics thought: make iterator implement io.Closer so samples can `defer iter.Close()`; but runtime should still handle ctx cancellation automatically — we shouldn't rely on users to always call Close.

ben: plan: add an internal ctx-watcher on iterator creation that calls an idempotent cleanup (sync.Once) to close ackCh safely. Also expose `ForEach(ctx, fn)` convenience to reduce Next/Err boilerplate in tutorials.

nora: love ForEach for onboarding. samples should show both quick ForEach and the manual pattern with `defer iter.Close()`. docs note: prefer ctx cancellation, but include Close as defensive pattern.

ashwin: prefer writer-owned channel close; signal writer to stop on ctx.Done() and have it close ackCh. sync.Once as guard is fine. Ensure Dedicated / Private adapters reuse same cleanup helper so bug isn't duplicated.

ben: i'll draft a PR with: io.Closer on iterator, sync.Once cleanup, ForEach helper, and unit/integration tests. tests: unit to assert ackCh closed exactly once; integration cancels after first token and asserts goroutine count returns to baseline within 200ms. mark integration to skip race detector in CI.

dev-bot: Issue created #371 — "go-sdk: generator handshake goroutine leak on ctx cancel"; PR draft opening soon.

mira: small UX: ForEach should accept func(ctx context.Context, tok Token) error so callers can early-return an error. also document cancellation semantics clearly in the SDK README.

ben: noted. will include that signature and docs. i'll tag the Dedicated runtime team for an audit in the PR checklist.

nora: thanks all. once PR lands i'll update the sample app and quickstart doc. ping here when ready. :rocket:
